newsitem.title: USA: ABC Bancorp closes First National merger.
newsitem.headline: ABC Bancorp closes First National merger.

text.p: ABC Bancorp said Friday it completed its merger with First National Financial Corp of Albany, Georgia.
The deal is valued at about $11.6 million, or 1.98 times the book value of First National Financial Corp, ABC Bancorp said.
The company said the merger will be paid with about 726,000 shares of its common stock. It added that the merger brings its assets to about $570 million.
The company said Raymond Phillips, First National president and chief executive officer, retired upon the merger. His successors as president and board chairman will be announced later, it said.
ABC Bancorp has eight banking subsidiaries with 21 locations in and around southern Georgia and southern Alabama.
